SELECT 
    id,
    session_id,
    stream_type,
    content,
    metadata,
    ROUND((1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 4) AS similarity
FROM knowledge_vault
WHERE stream_type = 'framework'
  AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) >= 0.70
ORDER BY (embedding <=> $1::vector) ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    id,
    session_id,
    stream_type,
    content,
    metadata,
    ROUND((1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 4) AS similarity
FROM knowledge_vault
WHERE stream_type = 'voice_sample'
  AND 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) >= 0.65
ORDER BY (embedding <=> $1::vector) ASC
LIMIT 2;
